$comment: The `ui <view>` roster, shared by both ports of reticle-protocol.
A view name the CLI accepts must, on BOTH platforms, either render or be refused
by a reason that names the platform boundary. What this fixture exists to forbid
is the third outcome: falling through to a generic 'unknown render view', which
is an internal error wearing a user-facing message — it names no boundary and
suggests no path, and it is exactly what `ui outline --target ios` did before
this file existed. The rule is docs/boundaries.md's: an unreachable thing must
produce evidence naming itself, never silence and never an internal error.
`platforms` is where the view RENDERS. A view missing a platform must carry a
`refusalMentions` list, and that platform's port is asserted to throw a message
containing every one of those substrings.
